the responsivity of a multiple-tunnelling superconductor can be enhanced by a factor of 10-100 by increasing the bias voltage to a value close to the superconducting gap.
the responsivity of small gap STJs can be enhanced by orders of magnitude by operating them with a bias voltage that is much higher than the superconducting gap.
